description: This file implements the CopyAssetPage component, a React frontend page for copying assets within a data asset management system. It manages user interactions for initiating asset copy requests, including form validation, confirmation modal, handling API calls to perform the copy, and optionally displaying copy lineage and status details.

methods.name: tryExtractCopyMetadata
methods.description: Extracts copy operation ID and target asset ID from a generic response object, handling different possible key capitalizations.

methods.name: statusPillClass
methods.description: Returns a CSS class string based on the copy status to style status indicator elements.

methods.name: submitCopy
methods.description: Handles the process of submitting a copy request, including validation, calling the API, handling success or error responses, and updating UI state.

methods.name: openConfirm
methods.description: Transitions the UI state to show the confirmation modal if the user is authorized and form is valid.

methods.name: closeConfirm
methods.description: Closes the confirmation modal, resets state.

methods.name: fetchLineage
methods.description: Fetches lineage data related to copy operations, managing fetch cancellation and handling errors.
